verdict.rationale: Supabase documents agent least-privilege controls on its MCP connection: project_ref scoping, read_only mode running as a read-only Postgres user, and feature-group allowlists. Its docs also prescribe approving only project-scoped, read-only tools for unattended agents, and the publishable key is limited by RLS. However, the docs themselves say PATs for agents must currently be granted all scopes, with fine-grained scopes only promised for the future, and the API-key model is a coarse publishable/secret split. Scoping is therefore mostly connection-level rather than true per-agent scoped credentials. missing for 10: fine-grained scoped PATs/tokens issuable per agent, per-agent credentials beyond the two-tier publishable/secret key model, independent corroboration of the scoping working in practice.
